claim: Charlie Kirk, the Turning Point USA co-founder assassinated on September 10, 2025, was one of the most prominent MAGA voices against a U.S. war with Iran in the months before his death. On his show and on X in June 2025 he attacked the 'radical interventionist faction' pushing 'regime change and boots on the ground,' called the regime-change argument 'pathologically insane,' and warned a new Middle East war 'makes Afghanistan and Iraq look like a cakewalk.' When President Trump ordered limited airstrikes on Iranian nuclear sites on June 21–22, 2025 with no ground troops, Kirk backed them, calling it 'a surgical strike, operated perfectly.' His widow, Erika Kirk, was named TPUSA CEO and board chair on September 18, 2025. After the United States opened a larger campaign against Iran — 'Operation Epic Fury,' begun February 28, 2026, nearly six months after Charlie's death — Erika Kirk posted support for U.S. troops ('Regardless of your opinion on Operation Epic Fury ... God bless our men and women in uniform') without taking a side on the war, and, pressed on where Charlie would have stood, said in a video that he is not there to state his own position and that 'it's frustrating when you have people speaking for him.'

notes: Surfaced by a reel contrasting Charlie Kirk's anti-Iran-war record against Erika Kirk's posture during the 2026 'Operation Epic Fury' war, arguing she 'didn't know him' / isn't honoring his legacy and insinuating his Iran stance is 'why they took him out.' Recorded straight, framings NOT adopted. Accuracy guardrails baked into the claim: (1) two Iran flashpoints — Trump's limited June 21-22, 2025 strikes (Charlie alive) vs. the larger Feb 28, 2026 'Operation Epic Fury' (Erika's remarks are about THIS, ~6 months after his death) — the reel blends them. (2) Charlie's record is two-phase: he opposed a regime-change war / boots on the ground (verbatim, Newsweek; 'pathologically insane,' 'cakewalk' both match the reel's own clip audio) BUT praised the narrow June 2025 strikes ('surgical strike, operated perfectly,' X 6/22/25) — so 'he was simply against any Iran action' would be inaccurate. (3) Erika did NOT say 'I'm unsure whether Charlie would support it'; she said he is not here to state his position and resented others 'speaking for him' (Yahoo confirms the fragment + the Epic Fury troops post; the fuller 'My husband isn't there to say whether or not we should be at war with Iran' is transcribed via Sportskeeda and corroborated by the reel's own audio). The 'killed over his Iran stance' insinuation is the same contested public claim already recorded under 2025-carlson-kirk-israel-001 (Carlson eulogy / Joe Kent) — see-also, not asserted here. The 'was she ever in love / real relationship' line is pure insinuation with no primary trace. Erika-video exact venue/date unverified (a spring-2026 TPUSA event per surfacing, not pinned). Editorial split a/b/c = 1/1/2.
